intro.html: Private replacements for the apps and services most people use every day — including every Google and Apple service. You don’t have to switch everything at once: pick the one you use most, swap it, and come back for the next. Each list shows the top picks from privacytools.io, in their order.

intro.label: Leaving Google or Apple?
intro.html: Download a copy of everything first — Google Takeout or Apple’s Data & Privacy page — then follow De-Google Yourself or De-Apple Yourself.
